_comment: OpenTripPlanner graph-build settings for RideIQ (TRANSIT_PLAN.md Phase 1).
OTP scans its build directory for inputs, so it picks up gtfs.zip and
edmonton.osm.pbf without either being named here.
transitServiceStart/End bound how much of the timetable is loaded: the ETS
feed only covers a few weeks, and a narrower window is a smaller graph.
